workingTreeInstall.description: A virtual environment .venv/ in the working tree (excluded by the repository's .gitignore) holds the third-party test dependencies only. Faker itself is NOT installed in it: neither as a regular copy (no `pip install .`) nor in editable mode (no `pip install -e .`).
commands: .venv/bin/python -m pip install tzdata freezegun "pytest>=6.0.1" "python-stdnum>=1.20" "ukpostcodeparser>=1.1.1" "validators>=0.13.0" pillow xmltodict   (Windows: .venv\Scripts\python.exe)
workingTreeInstall.projectItselfInstalled: no: `pip list` of the virtual environment holds no faker distribution, and `import faker` fails outside the repository root

evidenceWorkspace.description: The virtual environment stays where it is (C001-ADR-006 table, Python row): third-party distributions come from the environment the developer's environment selects. The project loads from the evidence workspace because the test command is `python -m pytest`, which puts the current directory (the workspace root) first on sys.path, and faker/ is a package at the repository root (flat layout). The project's pytest plugin (the `pytest11` entry point of an installed Faker) is loaded explicitly with `-p faker.contrib.pytest.plugin`, so no installation is needed.

ignoredPathsMadeAvailable.means: stays in the working tree and is selected through the active environment (VIRTUAL_ENV, PATH); not copied

activeEnvironment.description: The virtual environment <checkout>/.venv is active, as after `source .venv/bin/activate` (Windows: `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`): VIRTUAL_ENV is the .venv path and its bin directory (Windows: Scripts) is first on PATH, so `python` is the venv interpreter. The review is started from this shell in the repository root.

testCommandNotes: tests/pytest/test_unique_clear.py::test_unique_clears starts an inner pytest session (pytester) that needs the faker pytest plugin registered by an installed distribution; it cannot pass without installing the project, which the environment forbids, so it is deselected (1 test; all others pass). The project's tox runs a second invocation (`--exclusive-faker-session tests/pytest/session_overrides`); it is not part of the test command.
